title: Portfolio and group structure — Accelity Partners
metaDescription: How the Accelity Partners group is structured: the parent company, sector platforms, operating companies and market-facing brands, and how each relationship is described.

sections.headline: One group. Distinct companies. Clear roles.
sections.support: The brand a customer recognises is rarely the name of the legal entity. We keep the difference visible.

sections.heading: Four things worth separating.
sections.intro: Not every venture needs every layer. Some operating companies sit directly under Accelity Partners.

items.definition: Accelity Partners — the venture-building and holding company.
Used where it is relevant to the group structure, not created to fill a navigation group.
The entity responsible for running the business.
The identity customers know and use.

sections.footnote: We use the verified company tree. We do not create extra entities through design or shorthand.

sections.heading: A parent endorsement, not a visual takeover.
sections.intro: Each venture retains the identity that serves its audience. We apply an endorsement only once the relationship is verified and approved, and we use the wording that matches it.

rows.definition: An owned venture. The venture remains the lead identity.
A strategic relationship, described as agreed. It does not imply ownership or control.
An advisory engagement, named only with the client's approval.

sections.footnote: We never present an advisory client as a portfolio company.

sections.heading: Ventures are published once they are verified.

emptyState.heading: No venture profile has completed publication review yet.
emptyState.body: A venture appears here only when its release permission covers a public audience, the exact wording has been approved, and its operating stage and relationship to the group have been verified. Nothing on this page is a count of the group's companies.

sections.heading: Looking for a particular business?
sections.body: If you are trying to reach a specific venture, or you want to discuss a partnership at group level, tell us which and we will route it.
